depends_on.note: This contract carries @epic/@defect but does NOT restate their grammar. `tree_sha256` pins which epics/v1 surface the delegation was written against; `source_commit` is null in canon and MUST be filled by the vendoring consumer, whose conformance suite then verifies that the epics/v1 copy it vendored fingerprints to this same tree. Delegation that is only prose becomes a second copy of the regex; delegation that is pinned and checked cannot.
